flagged.title: Chapters 1-3: Arrival & Order
flagged.reason: F6 is mark-affecting because the video presents 'ugly without silliness' as Jack's dynamic reaction to losing the election rather than his initial physical description, teaching an inaccurate quotation context and analysis that would penalise a student on textual accuracy.

mark_affecting.quote: Golding describes Jack's face as going 'ugly without silliness'. It's this sudden flash of pure, dangerous pride.

flagged.title: Chapters 7-9: Savagery & Simon's Death
flagged.reason: The video explicitly presents 'a barrier, a prison' as a direct quotation from Golding, teaching students a fabricated quote when the word 'prison' does not appear in the novel.

mark_affecting.quote: He realizes the sea is, as Golding writes, 'a barrier, a prison'.

flagged.title: Key Themes & Exam Technique
flagged.reason: The video invents a two-part task format for the Eduqas post-1914 prose paper and falsely teaches that AO4 assesses historical context (AO4 is actually accurate written English, and context receives no marks on this question).
